fields.label: Endpoint Name
fields.description: Business name of the webhook endpoint.

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.description: Secret key used to sign webhook calls. This builder creates it as text; protected metadata behavior is not applied.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Indicates whether the webhook endpoint is active.

fields.label: Events
fields.description: Comma-separated event names sent to this endpoint, such as Deal Approved or Lead Converted.
